technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions on RSI-9/Stoch/Williams-R suggest potential bounce, but pervasive bearish structure (price below all key MAs, negative MACD, below cloud, weak ADX) and lack of bullish confirmation signals make this a low-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: CBRE shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 35 days present elevated risk with no offsetting fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (15/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional activity and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession, VIX at crisis levels (302.6), strong dollar pressures multinationals, FOMC just concluded, and real estate sector faces credit stress in tightening environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI-9, Stoch, Williams-R) near support (72.03) in fear-driven market create technical bounce potential with limited downside risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, negative MACD, below Ichimoku cloud, weak ADX), zero fundamental/smart-money support, elevated earnings risk in 35 days, and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, credit stress) make any bounce high-risk and likely temporary.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold technicals (RSI-9, Stoch, Williams-R) at support offer theoretical bounce potential, but pervasive bearish structure across all moving averages, negative MACD, and price below Ichimoku cloud eliminate conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (302.6), and credit stress in real estate sector create macro headwinds that will likely overwhelm any technical bounce; earnings in 35 days add execution risk with zero fundamental support.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish macro and fundamental weakness; only technical oversold conditions create minor bull case
